Categorized under the late canonical collections (*Suttas-Late-1*), the text recounts the biographical verse account associated with the elder (thera) Uppalahatthiya [SuttaCentral]. The SuttaCentral database indexes five modern translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].
